# Load data

```{r}
isolate_names <- list.dirs("../2025-08-25_batch1_NG-probe/spades/bowtie2/",recursive = F) %>% sort %>% unique %>% basename

amrfinder <- read_tsv("./data/amrfinder_clinical/amrfinder_clinical_master.tsv")
colnames(amrfinder) <- snakecase::to_snake_case(colnames(amrfinder) )%>% gsub("x_","",.)
amrfinder <- amrfinder %>% select(-protein_id,-hmm_accession,-hmm_description)  

# Curate new element_symbol
amrfinder$element_symbol_renamed <- apply(amrfinder,1,FUN=function(x){
  name <- x[["element_symbol"]] 
  # Get name
  if(x[["type"]] == "AMR" & x[["class"]] == "BETA-LACTAM" & x[["subtype"]] != "POINT"){
    if(grepl("-",name) == F| str_split(name,"-",simplify=T) %>% .[,ncol(.)] %>% grepl("[0-9]", .) ==F){
      if(x[["coverage_of_reference"]] < 100 | x[["identity_to_reference"]] < 100){
        name <- str_split(x[["closest_reference_name"]],pattern = " ",simplify = T) %>% .[,ncol(.)]  
        name <- ifelse(name == 'beta-lactamase',x[["element_symbol"]],paste0('bla',name))
      }
    }
  }
  if(grepl("ampC",x[["element_symbol"]])){
    name <- x[["element_symbol"]]
  }
  if(x[["coverage_of_reference"]] < 100){
    name <- paste0(name,"?")
  }
  if(x[["identity_to_reference"]] <100) {
    name <- paste0(name,"*")
  }
  # Point mutants
  if(x[["subtype"]] == "POINT"){
    name <- x[["element_symbol"]] 
  }
  return(name)
})

saveRDS(amrfinder,"./data/amrfinder_clinical/amrfinder_clinical_master_curated.RDS")
```

# Make matrix

```{r}
get_amrfinder_matrix <- function(amrfinder,isolates,name){
  unique_genes <- amrfinder[[name]] %>% unique
  pbmcapply::pbmclapply(unique_genes,FUN =function(x,amrfinder){
    isolates_with_gene <-  subset(amrfinder,get(name) == x) %>% select(assembly) %>% unlist
    row <- assign(paste0(x),ifelse(isolates %in% isolates_with_gene,1,0))
    return(row)},mc.cores=18,amrfinder) %>% do.call(bind_cols,.) %>% as.data.frame %>% `colnames<-`(unique_genes) %>% `rownames<-`(isolates)
}

amrfinder_mat <- get_amrfinder_matrix(amrfinder = amrfinder,isolates = isolate_names,name = "element_symbol")
amrfinder_mat_allele_aware <- get_amrfinder_matrix(amrfinder = amrfinder,isolates = isolate_names,name = 'element_symbol_renamed')
```

```{r}
saveRDS(amrfinder_mat,"./data/amrfinder_clinical/amrfinder_clinical_matrix.RDS")
saveRDS(amrfinder_mat_allele_aware,"./data/amrfinder_clinical/amrfinder_clinical_allele_aware_matrix.RDS")
```
